question: Did Hoshin transfer the idea of a stock market to Emilia’s world? If not, is there any chance that Subaru will be able to spread the idea?
answer: Hoshin didn’t transfer it, and I’d guess that a high school student who’s passingly familiar with anime and games hasn’t thought enough about stock markets to understand them well enough to be able to pass them on as culture to another world, so there’s no chance.
